finding.headline: "The Restaurant First-Timer"
finding.problem: "I just want to clink glasses with my husband and eat something warm. But what if she cries and everyone stares? What if I have to feed her and I'm exposed?"
finding.person: New mum who hasn't eaten a hot meal in a restaurant in 3 months; terrified of a public baby meltdown and of breastfeeding at the table in a conservative setting.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "The Hot-Meal Comeback: Dining Out With Baby (and Feeding Anywhere)."". Verdict: PASSES.
